motion.name: taiji-orbit
motion.purpose: 真实等待一周旋转；品牌静止。

reducedMotion.behavior: CSS 禁用全部 animation / transition 并使用 auto 滚动；studio.js 跳过视角动画并立即定位；太极静止。

focus.composer: 源码 textarea 无独立 outline，由容器赭色边界与 1px 底线表达。

extensions.snippetScope: 片段独立 HTML/CSS，无框架、Tailwind、外部图标或图片依赖；所有 class 使用 ds- 前缀。CSS 变量附浅色规范值作为 fallback，继承应用主题。选择菜单和等待片段仅示意外观，不模拟配置持久或 Runtime 事实。真实水墨 PNG 单独在 identity 中登记，不改绘为 SVG，也不内嵌重复的 1MB 资源。
extensions.paletteScope: No synthesized tonal ramps: this extraction records only source palette bindings and existing values.

sourceEvidence.hashNormalization: Text: decode UTF-8, normalize CRLF and lone CR to LF, encode UTF-8 without BOM; preserve final newline. Binary PNG: hash raw bytes.

materialFindings.finding: 56/36px alpha identity contrast in both themes
inactive temperature reset after provider change

catalogProbe.observedBy: root agent during this authorized task
catalogProbe.boundary: single recorded public catalog response, not current pricing guidance or a screenshot fixture price

sourceEvidence.scope: Only root DESIGN.md, .impeccable/design.json and .impeccable/surfaces/workbench.md were written. Current source, asset and existing review/report evidence were read; no UI/backend edit or QA rerun. Fixed browser/model transport and screenshot prices are fixtures, not remote-model quality, OAuth, billing or production proof.
sourceEvidence.reviewLimitations: Error/stale price states, expanded child parameters and Thinking popup have code/automatic-check evidence, without dedicated final screenshots in this review.

identity.origin: Built-in image_gen edit, user-directed 180-degree orientation, horizontal fish eyes and ink seam extensions, 2026-10-06
identity.promptVerified: Pillow image.load() completed, embedded text equals JSON prompt.
identity.visibleContract: 左黑、右奶油白；恰好两只相反颜色的鱼眼水平对齐；中央分界向左右延展为连续水墨波浪 M。180度旋转是用户编辑意图，当前像素形态以实际资产为准。
identity.alphaContour: drop-shadow(.3px 0 0 var(--ink-2)) drop-shadow(-.3px 0 0 var(--ink-2)) drop-shadow(0 .3px 0 var(--ink-2)) drop-shadow(0 -.3px 0 var(--ink-2))
identity.contourPurpose: 实际 alpha 的主题细轮廓，使56/36px的黑白两侧均可辨；零模糊，没有衬底或装饰光晕。
identity.authority: 用户明确的水墨替换和旋转/中缝延伸修订覆盖旧刚性几何品牌规范；微型等待保留原几何。

choices.dynamicSync: select, input[list] and existing provider/model options; remove popup when source is disconnected
choices.escape: dismiss open menu before owning dialog

bounds.outputLimit: model capability/catalog ceiling may narrow the configured output maximum

modelSettings.reasoning: 具体模型声明/实时发现的原生档位；未知能力保持默认或已保存值，不制造通用数值强度。
modelSettings.temperature: 普通OpenAI API模型传递temperature；推理/OAuth使用模型默认；新Claude模型省略不支持的采样参数。主/子停用控件重置0，避免切换后被不可编辑的超界值阻挡。

pricing.match: provider channel and exact model ID
pricing.unit: USD per million input/output tokens; optional contract override supports USD/CNY
pricing.freshness: show checked_at and stale state; explicit update action
pricing.unknown: absence, all-zero catalog placeholders, subscription/local channels are not assumed free
pricing.override: folded explicit contract-rate checkbox; absent price remains null
pricing.estimate: not a bill; cache discounts are not included
pricing.ownership: lookup outside Runtime transactions; new Run freezes resolved settings; automatic price/time excluded from user request identity; custom contract price included; existing/recovery Runs retain snapshots

narrative.overview:
安静、精确、有辨识度。界面用真实中文字体、宽松的工作面与清楚的细线组织内容；标题承担身份，控件承担操作，状态文字承担事实。奶油白与星空黑是固定的两种地色，原纸构首屏已移除。

空间如可展开的装帧：导航、会话、观测具有不同阅读密度，用户可显式折叠或进入专注。静态身份是一笔连贯的水墨太极波浪 M；微型几何太极只表达真实等待。主题与布局只拥有浏览器偏好，Runtime 的执行和验收事实继续由后端投影。
keyCharacteristics: 黑白地色、轻边界、克制的赭色动作与焦点。
本地中文字体，标题与操作文字有明确角色。
三栏可展开，正文与输入区共用阅读边线。
